provenance: AUTHORED, NOT EXTRACTED. NOTHING IN THIS MODEL COMES FROM THE ROM.
provenance_detail: Every plate, the rim, the raised art and the wordmark strip are authored geometry, generated by the owner's own tooling from the MEASURED DIMENSIONS recorded below. No ROM vertex, normal, display-list or pixel data is present. An earlier revision that reused the original plates, their normals and their text-quad positions was DISCARDED for exactly that reason; this model shares no geometry with it. Authored rounded corners need real segments, which is why this costs 710 triangles where the discarded revision cost 310.

metrics_measured_from_original.note: Dimensions and proportions MEASURED from the original prop. These are facts about a layout, not asset data, and no ROM geometry is reproduced from them.

texture_refs_note: DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and it must stay that way while this model has no game texture in it. Every one of the six images is the author's own artwork, so the importer reports zero references and the package resolves nothing from the player's ROM. An earlier revision did reference rareware.env_field and carried an authored placeholder standing in for it; both the reference and the placeholder are gone. A stale entry here would name a texture this package no longer has - at best an error, at worst a silent wrong resolution.
textures_authored: All six images are embedded, and each carries extras.sl_authored with its own provenance string in the glTF - the declaration --repo checks before allowing any pixels into a committed model. None is resampled from, traced from, or derived from any ROM texture.
texgen_note: LOAD-BEARING. Materials 0 (N64-field) and 1 (N64-gold) BOTH declare extras.sl_texgen true, and both declarations must survive any re-export. Nothing implies generated coordinates for them any more - the reference that used to imply it on material 0 is gone - so without the explicit declarations both reflective materials fall back to baked UVs and the logo renders FLAT. That failure is silent: the geometry is still correct and it still draws, it just looks dull rather than broken.
